label: Marking a research/audit item RESOLVED based on a title/single-source without an artifact-existence probe + >=2 independent evidence checks
why: Marking an item RESOLVED requires (1) an artifact-existence probe (ls/Read/curl the actual deliverable exists) AND (2) at least two independent evidence checks. Calling it resolved off a single source's title — without opening the artifact or corroborating — is freshness fabrication. The item is unverified until probed + double-sourced.
